metadata.title: LearningO - Science / Write
metadata.subject: Science
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question requires production, not recognition - spelling, labelling, predicting, or explaining in the child's own words.
The module climbs deliberately from single-word science spelling to full explanatory paragraphs, so type 15 is genuinely harder than type 1.
Diagram labelling (typed and dragged) connects written vocabulary directly to visual science understanding.
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
Cause-effect, prediction, and explanation items (11-15) deliberately require reasoning in writing, not just a memorised fact.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Open-ended writing items (13, 14, 15) are scored for genuine attempt and relevant science content, not a single fixed string.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: turning a known science concept into correct spelling from scratch
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Pure production spelling of science vocabulary, no letters or word bank given.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: ordering known letters into the correct science-word sequence
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Removes the recall burden of free typing, isolating whether the child can sequence a science word's sounds.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: filling a specific gap in a science word using surrounding letters as scaffolding
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A scaffolded step between letter-bank and free spelling of science vocabulary.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: recalling and spelling a specific diagram part's name
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Connects diagram knowledge directly to written vocabulary production, a real science-report skill.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: physically placing a provided label onto the correct part of a diagram
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A motor-light alternative to typed labelling, isolating diagram knowledge from spelling.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: identifying and rewriting the incorrect part of a science sentence
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Combines fact verification with production - the child must know the fix, not just spot the error.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: selecting the correct science word from options to complete a sentence
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Cloze-style science sentence completion, scaffolded with word choices.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: recalling and spelling one specific science term in response to a question
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Free-recall single-word science answers, no options to lean on.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: applying a classification rule and producing the category label in writing
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Combines classification reasoning with written production of the category name itself.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a written description of a specific process stage
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests process knowledge through free writing, not just ordering pre-given steps.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a written prediction based on a stated cause
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Free-recall cause-and-effect reasoning, requiring production rather than selection.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an unstated outcome in writing
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond cause-and-effect - genuine forward prediction using accumulated science knowledge.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a precise written description of an observed detail
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Observation is a foundational scientific skill, distinct from recall or prediction - noticing precisely what's there.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing several connected original sentences about a science topic
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - genuine extended science writing, the destination all other Write types build toward.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.instruction: Look at the picture. Type the word.
hints: Sound it out slowly: but-ter-fly.
questions.worked_example: Say it slowly, sound by sound. Type one letter for each sound.

feedback.correct: Butterfly. Correctly spelled. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Break it into parts and sound each one out.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: encoding a science concept into spelling

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Noticing small creatures around you is where real curiosity starts.

analysis.primary_construct: turning a known science concept into correct spelling from scratch
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Pure production spelling of science vocabulary, no letters or word bank given.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Reversed letters here (b/d) are a spelling-stage marker, separate from any science-knowledge confusion.
analysis.parent_note: Free typing science words is harder than picking from choices, and shows real ownership of the vocabulary.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Say the word slowly and write one sound at a time.

es.instruction: Mira la imagen. Escribe la palabra.
hints: Separa el sonido lentamente: ma-ri-po-sa.

feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

analysis.primary_construct: physically placing a provided label onto the correct part of a diagram
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A motor-light alternative to typed labelling, isolating diagram knowledge from spelling.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Placing a label on an adjacent but wrong part shows the diagram's layout, not the label itself, needs review.
analysis.parent_note: Dragging labels removes the spelling step, isolating pure diagram understanding.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Point to each part of a real diagram and say its name before dragging.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Drag the correct label onto the diagram.
questions.prompt: Drag 'pupil' to the dark centre of the eye.

distractor_insight.iris: confused pupil with the surrounding coloured part

hints: The pupil is the small dark circle right in the centre.
questions.worked_example: Read the label first. Then scan the diagram for that exact part.

feedback.correct: Pupil. Correctly placed at the centre, told apart from the iris. 👁️
feedback.incorrect: The pupil is the dark centre, different from the coloured ring around it.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: matching a science label to its diagram position

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Your pupil actually changes size depending on how much light is around you.

analysis.primary_construct: physically placing a provided label onto the correct part of a diagram
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A motor-light alternative to typed labelling, isolating diagram knowledge from spelling.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Placing a label on an adjacent but wrong part shows the diagram's layout, not the label itself, needs review.
analysis.parent_note: Dragging labels removes the spelling step, isolating pure diagram understanding.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Point to each part of a real diagram and say its name before dragging.

es.instruction: Arrastra la etiqueta correcta al diagrama.

feedback.incorrect: La pupila es el centro oscuro, diferente del anillo de color que la rodea.

feedback.incorrect: Die Pupille ist die dunkle Mitte, anders als der farbige Ring darum.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

hints: De pupil is het kleine donkere rondje precies in het midden.

feedback.incorrect: De pupil is het donkere midden, anders dan de gekleurde ring daaromheen.

ru.prompt: Перетащи «зрачок» на тёмный центр глаза.
hints: Зрачок — это маленький тёмный круг прямо в центре.

feedback.correct: Зрачок. Правильно помещён в центре, отличён от радужки. 👁️
feedback.incorrect: Зрачок — это тёмный центр, отличный от цветного кольца вокруг него.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.prompt: 'göz bebeği' etiketini gözün koyu merkezine sürükle.
hints: Göz bebeği, tam ortadaki küçük koyu dairedir.
tr.worked_example: Etiketi önce oku. Sonra diyagramda tam olarak o parçayı ara.

ja.instruction: 正しいラベルを図にドラッグしよう。

hints: 瞳は真ん中にある小さな黒い丸です。

feedback.incorrect: 瞳は真ん中の黒い部分で、周りの色のついた輪(虹彩)とは違います。

ko.prompt: '동공'을 눈의 어두운 가운데 부분에 끌어다 놓으세요.
hints: 동공은 바로 가운데에 있는 작고 어두운 동그라미예요.
ko.worked_example: 이름표를 먼저 읽으세요. 그다음 그림에서 그 정확한 부분을 찾으세요.

feedback.correct: 동공. 가운데에 정확히 놓았어요, 홍채와 구별했어요. 👁️
feedback.incorrect: 동공은 가운데의 어두운 부분으로, 그 주변의 색깔 있는 테와는 달라요.

id.instruction: Seret label yang benar ke diagramnya.

feedback.incorrect: Pupil adalah bagian tengah yang gelap, berbeda dari cincin berwarna di sekitarnya.

vi.instruction: Kéo nhãn đúng vào sơ đồ.
vi.prompt: Kéo 'con ngươi' vào phần trung tâm màu đen của con mắt.
hints: Con ngươi là vòng tròn nhỏ màu đen ngay chính giữa.

feedback.incorrect: Con ngươi là phần đen ở trung tâm, khác với vòng màu bao quanh nó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Fix the sentence so it becomes true.
questions.prompt: Fish live on the moon.
hints: Where do fish actually live?
questions.worked_example: Find the one wrong word. Type a true word to replace it.

feedback.correct: Fish live in water. Correctly fixed. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Find the one wrong word - where do fish really live?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: correcting a false science statement

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Fish breathe through gills, made specifically for living in water.

analysis.primary_construct: identifying and rewriting the incorrect part of a science sentence
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Combines fact verification with production - the child must know the fix, not just spot the error.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Fixing the wrong word (one that wasn't actually incorrect) shows the false part wasn't precisely located.
analysis.parent_note: This shows real science knowledge - fixing a mistake takes more than just knowing something is wrong.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Read the sentence aloud and ask what part sounds wrong before typing the fix.

academic.skill: classifying and writing the category name

life_skill.primary: Classifying and naming states of matter
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Every material on Earth is one of these three states, or changing between them.

analysis.primary_construct: applying a classification rule and producing the category label in writing
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Combines classification reasoning with written production of the category name itself.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Naming a specific example instead of the general category shows the classification level, not the example, needs work.
analysis.parent_note: Writing the category name, not just picking an example, shows a stronger grasp of the concept.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'what group is this' out loud before typing the category.

academic.skill: writing a specific, factual observation

analysis.primary_construct: producing a precise written description of an observed detail
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Observation is a foundational scientific skill, distinct from recall or prediction - noticing precisely what's there.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A vague observation ('it's nice') instead of a specific one ('it's yellow and round') shows precision, not attention, needs support.
analysis.parent_note: Precise, specific observations are the raw material every scientist works from.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Play 'I notice' games together, encouraging specific details over general comments.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why, in one or two sentences.
questions.prompt: Why do we wash our hands before eating?
hints: Think about what's on your hands before food.
questions.worked_example: Say your explanation out loud first. Then write down what you said.

feedback.correct: Germs - your hands touch everything before they touch your food. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud first: what's on your hands before you wash them?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Hands go everywhere, then they go to your mouth.

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why' after sharing any science fact, and let your child answer before writing.

hints: Pense no que há nas suas mãos antes da comida.
pt.worked_example: Diga sua explicação em voz alta primeiro. Depois escreva o que você disse.

feedback.correct: Germes - suas mãos tocam tudo antes de tocar na sua comida. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Diga em voz alta primeiro: o que há nas suas mãos antes de você lavá-las?

it.instruction: Spiega perché, in una o due frasi.
it.prompt: Perché ci laviamo le mani prima di mangiare?
hints: Pensa a cosa c'è sulle tue mani prima del cibo.
it.worked_example: Di' prima la tua spiegazione ad alta voce. Poi scrivi quello che hai detto.

feedback.correct: Germi - le tue mani toccano tutto prima di toccare il tuo cibo. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Dillo prima ad alta voce: cosa c'è sulle tue mani prima di lavarle?

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum waschen wir uns vor dem Essen die Hände?
hints: Denk darüber nach, was vor dem Essen auf deinen Händen ist.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Erklärung zuerst laut aus. Schreib dann auf, was du gesagt hast.

feedback.correct: Keime – deine Hände berühren alles, bevor sie dein Essen berühren. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es zuerst laut aus: Was ist auf deinen Händen, bevor du sie wäschst?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Leg uit waarom, in één of twee zinnen.
nl.prompt: Waarom wassen we onze handen voor het eten?
hints: Denk aan wat er op je handen zit voordat je eet.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je uitleg eerst hardop. Schrijf dan op wat je zei.

feedback.correct: Kiemen - je handen raken alles aan voordat ze je eten aanraken. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het eerst hardop: wat zit er op je handen voordat je ze wast?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.
ru.prompt: Почему мы моем руки перед едой?
hints: Подумай, что есть на твоих руках перед едой.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи своё объяснение вслух. Потом запиши то, что сказал.

feedback.correct: Микробы — твои руки касаются всего, прежде чем коснуться еды. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Сначала скажи вслух: что есть на твоих руках, пока ты их не помыл?

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Yemek yemeden önce neden ellerimizi yıkarız?
hints: Yemekten önce ellerinde ne olduğunu düşün.
tr.worked_example: Önce açıklamanı sesli söyle. Sonra söylediklerini yaz.

feedback.correct: Mikroplar - eller yemeğe dokunmadan önce her şeye dokunur. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Önce sesli söyle: ellerini yıkamadan önce üzerlerinde ne var?

hints: 想一想吃东西之前你的手上有什么。

feedback.correct: 细菌——你的手在碰到食物之前会碰到各种东西。🧼
feedback.incorrect: 先大声说出来:洗手前你的手上有什么?

ja.instruction: 理由を1つか2つの文で説明しよう。
ja.prompt: 食べる前に手を洗うのはなぜ?
hints: 食べ物に触れる前の手に何があるか考えよう。

feedback.incorrect: まず声に出して言おう:洗う前の手には何がある?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 우리는 왜 밥 먹기 전에 손을 씻나요?
hints: 밥을 먹기 전에 손에 무엇이 있는지 생각해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 설명을 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요. 그다음 말한 것을 적으세요.

feedback.correct: 세균 때문이에요 - 손은 음식에 닿기 전에 온갖 것에 닿아요. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요: 씻기 전에 손에 무엇이 있나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Jelaskan mengapa, dalam satu atau dua kalimat.
id.prompt: Mengapa kita mencuci tangan sebelum makan?
hints: Pikirkan apa yang ada di tanganmu sebelum makanan.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan penjelasanmu dengan lantang dulu. Lalu tuliskan apa yang kamu ucapkan.

feedback.correct: Kuman - tanganmu menyentuh segalanya sebelum menyentuh makananmu. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan dulu dengan lantang: apa yang ada di tanganmu sebelum kamu mencucinya?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Giải thích vì sao, trong một hoặc hai câu.
vi.prompt: Vì sao chúng ta rửa tay trước khi ăn?
hints: Nghĩ về điều gì có trên tay bạn trước khi ăn.
vi.worked_example: Nói lời giải thích của bạn thành tiếng trước. Rồi viết ra điều bạn đã nói.

feedback.correct: Vi trùng - tay bạn chạm vào mọi thứ trước khi chạm vào thức ăn. 🧼
feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng trước: điều gì có trên tay bạn trước khi bạn rửa tay?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why, in one or two sentences.
questions.prompt: Why do plants need sunlight?
hints: What do plants use sunlight to do?
questions.worked_example: Say your explanation out loud first. Then write down what you said.

feedback.correct: To make their own food - sunlight powers a plant's whole growth process. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud: what does a plant actually do with sunlight?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Plants use sunlight to make their own food, a process called photosynthesis.

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why' after sharing any science fact, and let your child answer before writing.

es.instruction: Explica por qué, en una o dos frases.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué las plantas necesitan luz solar?
hints: ¿Para qué usan las plantas la luz solar?
es.worked_example: Di tu explicación en voz alta primero. Luego escribe lo que dijiste.

feedback.correct: Para producir su propio alimento - la luz solar impulsa todo el proceso de crecimiento de una planta. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Dilo en voz alta: ¿qué hace realmente una planta con la luz solar?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Explique pourquoi, en une ou deux phrases.

feedback.correct: Pour fabriquer leur propre nourriture - le soleil alimente toute la croissance d'une plante. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Dis-le à voix haute : que fait vraiment une plante avec le soleil ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Explique por quê, em uma ou duas frases.

feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Spiega perché, in una o due frasi.

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum brauchen Pflanzen Sonnenlicht?

feedback.incorrect: Sprich es laut aus: Was macht eine Pflanze eigentlich mit Sonnenlicht?

feedback.incorrect: Zeg het hardop: wat doet een plant eigenlijk met zonlicht?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.

hints: Для чего растения используют солнечный свет?

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Bitkilerin güneş ışığına neden ihtiyacı vardır?
hints: Bitkiler güneş ışığını ne yapmak için kullanır?

zh.prompt: 植物为什么需要阳光?

ko.prompt: 식물은 왜 햇빛이 필요한가요?

id.instruction: Jelaskan mengapa, dalam satu atau dua kalimat.

vi.instruction: Giải thích vì sao, trong một hoặc hai câu.

feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng: cây thực sự dùng ánh sáng mặt trời để làm gì?

questions.subject: Science

feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud: what does the sun's warmth do to ice?

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.

feedback.incorrect: Dillo ad alta voce: cosa fa il calore del sole al ghiaccio?

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.

it.worked_example: Di' prima la tua spiegazione ad alta voce. Poi scrivi quello che hai detto.

feedback.correct: Immagazzina energia per il grande cambiamento che avviene dentro il bozzolo. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Dillo ad alta voce: cosa sta preparando davvero tutto quel mangiare per il bruco?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum muss eine Raupe so viel essen, bevor sie einen Kokon bildet?
hints: Denk darüber nach, wofür all das Fressen Vorräte anlegt.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Erklärung zuerst laut aus. Schreib dann auf, was du gesagt hast.

feedback.correct: Sie speichert Energie für die große Veränderung, die im Kokon passiert. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es laut aus: Worauf bereitet all das Fressen die Raupe eigentlich vor?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Leg uit waarom, in één of twee zinnen.
nl.prompt: Waarom moet een rups zoveel eten voordat hij een cocon vormt?
hints: Denk aan wat al dat eten opslaat voor later.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je uitleg eerst hardop. Schrijf dan op wat je zei.

feedback.correct: Hij slaat energie op voor de enorme verandering die plaatsvindt in de cocon. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het hardop: waarop bereidt al dat eten de rups eigenlijk voor?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.
ru.prompt: Почему гусенице нужно есть так много, прежде чем сформировать кокон?
hints: Подумай, что вся эта еда запасает на будущее.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи своё объяснение вслух. Потом запиши то, что сказал.

feedback.correct: Она запасает энергию для огромного изменения, которое происходит внутри кокона. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Скажи вслух: к чему на самом деле готовит гусеницу вся эта еда?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Bir tırtıl koza oluşturmadan önce neden bu kadar çok yemeye ihtiyaç duyar?
hints: Tüm o yemenin sonrası için neyi depoladığını düşün.
tr.worked_example: Önce açıklamanı sesli söyle. Sonra söylediklerini yaz.

feedback.correct: Kozanın içinde gerçekleşecek büyük değişim için enerji depolar. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Sesli söyle: tüm o yemek tırtılı gerçekte neye hazırlıyor?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.prompt: 毛毛虫结茧之前为什么需要吃这么多东西?
hints: 想一想吃这么多东西是在为之后储存什么。
zh.worked_example: 先把你的解释大声说出来。然后把你说的话写下来。

feedback.correct: 它在储存能量,为茧里发生的巨大变化做准备。🐛
feedback.incorrect: 大声说出来:毛毛虫吃这么多东西到底是在为什么做准备?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 理由を1つか2つの文で説明しよう。
ja.prompt: 幼虫がさなぎになる前にたくさん食べる必要があるのはなぜ?
hints: そのたくさんの食事は、後のために何を蓄えているか考えよう。
ja.worked_example: まず説明を声に出して言おう。それから、言ったことを書こう。

feedback.correct: さなぎの中で起こる大きな変化のためにエネルギーを蓄えている。🐛
feedback.incorrect: 声に出して言おう:そのたくさんの食事は幼虫を実際に何のために準備している?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 애벌레는 번데기를 만들기 전에 왜 그렇게 많이 먹어야 하나요?
hints: 그 많은 먹기가 나중을 위해 무엇을 저장하는지 생각해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 설명을 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요. 그다음 말한 것을 적으세요.

feedback.correct: 번데기 안에서 일어나는 큰 변화를 위한 에너지를 저장하는 거예요. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: 소리 내어 말해 보세요: 그 많은 먹기가 애벌레에게 실제로 무엇을 준비시켜 주나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Jelaskan mengapa, dalam satu atau dua kalimat.
id.prompt: Mengapa seekor ulat perlu makan sangat banyak sebelum membentuk kepompong?
hints: Pikirkan untuk apa semua makan itu menyimpan cadangan nantinya.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan penjelasanmu dengan lantang dulu. Lalu tuliskan apa yang kamu ucapkan.

feedback.correct: Ia menyimpan energi untuk perubahan besar yang terjadi di dalam kepompong. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan dengan lantang: sebenarnya untuk apa semua makan itu mempersiapkan si ulat?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Giải thích vì sao, trong một hoặc hai câu.
vi.prompt: Vì sao sâu bướm cần ăn nhiều như vậy trước khi làm kén?
hints: Nghĩ về điều mà tất cả việc ăn đó đang dự trữ cho sau này.
vi.worked_example: Nói lời giải thích của bạn thành tiếng trước. Rồi viết ra điều bạn đã nói.

feedback.correct: Nó dự trữ năng lượng cho sự biến đổi lớn xảy ra bên trong kén. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng: tất cả việc ăn đó thực sự đang chuẩn bị cho sâu bướm làm gì?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why, in one or two sentences.
questions.prompt: Why is it dangerous to leave meat out in a hot car all day?
hints: Think about what warmth does to bacteria on food.
questions.worked_example: Say your explanation out loud first. Then write down what you said.

feedback.correct: Warmth lets bacteria multiply quickly, which can make the food unsafe. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud: what happens to bacteria in warm conditions?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This exact chain of reasoning is why food left in warm places for a long time can become unsafe.

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why' after sharing any science fact, and let your child answer before writing.

es.instruction: Explica por qué, en una o dos frases.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué es peligroso dejar carne en un auto caliente todo el día?
hints: Piensa en qué le hace el calor a las bacterias en la comida.
es.worked_example: Di tu explicación en voz alta primero. Luego escribe lo que dijiste.

feedback.correct: El calor permite que las bacterias se multipliquen rápidamente, lo que puede hacer que la comida no sea segura. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Dilo en voz alta: ¿qué les pasa a las bacterias en condiciones de calor?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Explique pourquoi, en une ou deux phrases.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi est-il dangereux de laisser de la viande toute la journée dans une voiture chaude ?
hints: Pense à ce que la chaleur fait aux bactéries sur la nourriture.
fr.worked_example: Dis ton explication à voix haute d'abord. Puis écris ce que tu as dit.

feedback.correct: La chaleur permet aux bactéries de se multiplier rapidement, ce qui peut rendre la nourriture dangereuse. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Dis-le à voix haute : que se passe-t-il pour les bactéries par temps chaud ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Explique por quê, em uma ou duas frases.
pt.prompt: Por que é perigoso deixar carne num carro quente o dia todo?
hints: Pense no que o calor faz com as bactérias na comida.
pt.worked_example: Diga sua explicação em voz alta primeiro. Depois escreva o que você disse.

feedback.correct: O calor deixa as bactérias se multiplicarem rapidamente, o que pode tornar a comida insegura. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Diga em voz alta: o que acontece com as bactérias em condições de calor?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Spiega perché, in una o due frasi.
it.prompt: Perché è pericoloso lasciare la carne in un'auto calda per tutto il giorno?
hints: Pensa a cosa fa il calore ai batteri sul cibo.
it.worked_example: Di' prima la tua spiegazione ad alta voce. Poi scrivi quello che hai detto.

feedback.correct: Il calore permette ai batteri di moltiplicarsi velocemente, il che può rendere il cibo non sicuro. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Dillo ad alta voce: cosa succede ai batteri in condizioni calde?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum ist es gefährlich, Fleisch den ganzen Tag in einem heißen Auto liegen zu lassen?
hints: Denk darüber nach, was Wärme mit Bakterien auf Lebensmitteln macht.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Erklärung zuerst laut aus. Schreib dann auf, was du gesagt hast.

feedback.correct: Wärme lässt Bakterien sich schnell vermehren, was das Essen unsicher machen kann. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es laut aus: Was passiert mit Bakterien bei Wärme?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Leg uit waarom, in één of twee zinnen.
nl.prompt: Waarom is het gevaarlijk om vlees de hele dag in een hete auto te laten liggen?
hints: Denk aan wat warmte doet met bacteriën op voedsel.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je uitleg eerst hardop. Schrijf dan op wat je zei.

feedback.correct: Warmte laat bacteriën zich snel vermenigvuldigen, waardoor het voedsel onveilig kan worden. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het hardop: wat gebeurt er met bacteriën in warme omstandigheden?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.
ru.prompt: Почему опасно оставлять мясо в жаркой машине на весь день?
hints: Подумай, что тепло делает с бактериями на еде.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи своё объяснение вслух. Потом запиши то, что сказал.

feedback.correct: Тепло позволяет бактериям быстро размножаться, из-за чего еда может стать опасной. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Скажи вслух: что происходит с бактериями в тёплых условиях?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Eti bütün gün sıcak bir arabada bırakmak neden tehlikelidir?
hints: Sıcaklığın yiyecekteki bakterilere ne yaptığını düşün.
tr.worked_example: Önce açıklamanı sesli söyle. Sonra söylediklerini yaz.

feedback.correct: Sıcaklık, bakterilerin hızla çoğalmasına izin verir, bu da yiyeceği güvensiz hale getirebilir. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Sesli söyle: sıcak koşullarda bakterilere ne olur?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.prompt: 把肉整天放在炎热的车里为什么很危险?
hints: 想一想温暖对食物上的细菌会有什么影响。
zh.worked_example: 先把你的解释大声说出来。然后把你说的话写下来。

feedback.correct: 温暖让细菌快速繁殖,这会让食物变得不安全。🍱
feedback.incorrect: 大声说出来:细菌在温暖的环境里会怎样?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 理由を1つか2つの文で説明しよう。
ja.prompt: 暑い車の中に一日中肉を置いておくのが危険なのはなぜ?
hints: 暖かさは食べ物の中の細菌に何をするか考えよう。
ja.worked_example: まず説明を声に出して言おう。それから、言ったことを書こう。

feedback.correct: 暖かさで細菌が速く増え、食べ物が安全でなくなることがある。🍱
feedback.incorrect: 声に出して言おう:暖かい状態で細菌はどうなる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 고기를 뜨거운 차 안에 하루 종일 두는 것이 왜 위험한가요?
hints: 따뜻함이 음식 속 세균에 무엇을 하는지 생각해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 설명을 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요. 그다음 말한 것을 적으세요.

feedback.correct: 따뜻함은 세균이 빠르게 늘어나게 해서, 음식이 안전하지 않게 될 수 있어요. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: 소리 내어 말해 보세요: 따뜻한 환경에서 세균에게 무슨 일이 일어나나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Jelaskan mengapa, dalam satu atau dua kalimat.
id.prompt: Mengapa berbahaya meninggalkan daging di mobil panas sepanjang hari?
hints: Pikirkan apa yang dilakukan kehangatan pada bakteri di makanan.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan penjelasanmu dengan lantang dulu. Lalu tuliskan apa yang kamu ucapkan.

feedback.correct: Kehangatan membuat bakteri berkembang biak dengan cepat, yang bisa membuat makanan tidak aman. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan dengan lantang: apa yang terjadi pada bakteri dalam kondisi hangat?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Giải thích vì sao, trong một hoặc hai câu.
vi.prompt: Vì sao để thịt trong xe nóng suốt cả ngày lại nguy hiểm?
hints: Nghĩ về điều hơi ấm làm với vi khuẩn trên thức ăn.
vi.worked_example: Nói lời giải thích của bạn thành tiếng trước. Rồi viết ra điều bạn đã nói.

feedback.correct: Hơi ấm khiến vi khuẩn sinh sôi nhanh chóng, có thể làm thức ăn không an toàn. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng: điều gì xảy ra với vi khuẩn trong điều kiện ấm?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why, in one or two sentences.
questions.prompt: Why does a fair science test only change one thing at a time?
hints: Think about what would happen if you changed several things at once.
questions.worked_example: Say your explanation out loud first. Then write down what you said.

feedback.correct: Changing only one thing lets you fairly see exactly what caused any difference. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud: what would go wrong if you changed several things at once?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Changing only one thing at a time is the whole secret to a fair experiment.

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why' after sharing any science fact, and let your child answer before writing.

es.instruction: Explica por qué, en una o dos frases.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué una prueba científica justa solo cambia una cosa a la vez?
hints: Piensa en qué pasaría si cambiaras varias cosas a la vez.
es.worked_example: Di tu explicación en voz alta primero. Luego escribe lo que dijiste.

feedback.correct: Cambiar solo una cosa te permite ver con justicia exactamente qué causó cualquier diferencia. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Dilo en voz alta: ¿qué saldría mal si cambiaras varias cosas a la vez?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Explique pourquoi, en une ou deux phrases.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi un test scientifique équitable ne change-t-il qu'une seule chose à la fois ?
hints: Pense à ce qui se passerait si tu changeais plusieurs choses à la fois.
fr.worked_example: Dis ton explication à voix haute d'abord. Puis écris ce que tu as dit.

feedback.correct: Changer une seule chose te permet de voir clairement ce qui a vraiment causé une différence. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Dis-le à voix haute : que se passerait-il de problématique si tu changeais plusieurs choses à la fois ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Explique por quê, em uma ou duas frases.
pt.prompt: Por que um teste científico justo muda apenas uma coisa por vez?
hints: Pense no que aconteceria se você mudasse várias coisas ao mesmo tempo.
pt.worked_example: Diga sua explicação em voz alta primeiro. Depois escreva o que você disse.

feedback.correct: Mudar apenas uma coisa permite ver exatamente o que causou qualquer diferença. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Diga em voz alta: o que daria errado se você mudasse várias coisas ao mesmo tempo?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Spiega perché, in una o due frasi.
it.prompt: Perché un test scientifico equo cambia solo una cosa alla volta?
hints: Pensa a cosa succederebbe se cambiassi più cose insieme.
it.worked_example: Di' prima la tua spiegazione ad alta voce. Poi scrivi quello che hai detto.

feedback.correct: Cambiare solo una cosa ti permette di vedere con certezza cosa ha causato ogni differenza. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Dillo ad alta voce: cosa andrebbe storto se cambiassi diverse cose alla volta?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum verändert ein faires wissenschaftliches Experiment immer nur eine Sache auf einmal?
hints: Denk darüber nach, was passieren würde, wenn du mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig änderst.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Erklärung zuerst laut aus. Schreib dann auf, was du gesagt hast.

feedback.correct: Nur eine Sache zu ändern lässt dich fair erkennen, was genau einen Unterschied verursacht hat. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es laut aus: Was würde schiefgehen, wenn du mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig änderst?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Leg uit waarom, in één of twee zinnen.
nl.prompt: Waarom verandert een eerlijke wetenschappelijke test maar één ding tegelijk?
hints: Denk aan wat er zou gebeuren als je meerdere dingen tegelijk zou veranderen.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je uitleg eerst hardop. Schrijf dan op wat je zei.

feedback.correct: Door maar één ding te veranderen, kun je eerlijk zien wat precies het verschil veroorzaakte. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het hardop: wat zou er misgaan als je meerdere dingen tegelijk zou veranderen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.
ru.prompt: Почему в честном научном эксперименте меняют только одну вещь за раз?
hints: Подумай, что произошло бы, если бы ты изменил несколько вещей одновременно.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи своё объяснение вслух. Потом запиши то, что сказал.

feedback.correct: Изменение только одной вещи позволяет честно увидеть, что именно вызвало различие. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Скажи вслух: что пошло бы не так, если бы ты изменил несколько вещей одновременно?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Adil bir bilim deneyi neden aynı anda sadece bir şeyi değiştirir?
hints: Aynı anda birkaç şeyi değiştirirsen ne olacağını düşün.
tr.worked_example: Önce açıklamanı sesli söyle. Sonra söylediklerini yaz.

feedback.correct: Sadece bir şeyi değiştirmek, herhangi bir farkın neyin sebep olduğunu adil bir şekilde görmeni sağlar. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Sesli söyle: aynı anda birkaç şeyi değiştirirsen ne ters gider?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.prompt: 一个公平的科学实验为什么一次只改变一个条件?
hints: 想一想如果一次改变好几个条件会发生什么。
zh.worked_example: 先把你的解释大声说出来。然后把你说的话写下来。

feedback.correct: 只改变一个条件能让你清楚地看出究竟是什么导致了差异。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 大声说出来:如果一次改变好几个条件,会出什么问题?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 理由を1つか2つの文で説明しよう。
ja.prompt: 公正な科学実験で一度に1つのことしか変えないのはなぜ?
hints: 一度にいくつも変えたら何が起こるか考えよう。
ja.worked_example: まず説明を声に出して言おう。それから、言ったことを書こう。

feedback.correct: 1つだけ変えることで、何が違いの原因なのかを正しく見ることができる。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 声に出して言おう:一度にいくつも変えたら何がうまくいかなくなる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 공정한 과학 실험은 왜 한 번에 한 가지만 바꾸나요?
hints: 여러 가지를 한꺼번에 바꾸면 무슨 일이 생길지 생각해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 설명을 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요. 그다음 말한 것을 적으세요.

feedback.correct: 한 가지만 바꾸면 그 차이를 정확히 무엇이 일으켰는지 공정하게 알 수 있어요. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: 소리 내어 말해 보세요: 여러 가지를 한꺼번에 바꾸면 무엇이 잘못될까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Jelaskan mengapa, dalam satu atau dua kalimat.
id.prompt: Mengapa sebuah tes sains yang adil hanya mengubah satu hal pada satu waktu?
hints: Pikirkan apa yang akan terjadi jika kamu mengubah beberapa hal sekaligus.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan penjelasanmu dengan lantang dulu. Lalu tuliskan apa yang kamu ucapkan.

feedback.correct: Mengubah hanya satu hal membuatmu bisa melihat dengan adil apa yang sebenarnya menyebabkan perbedaan. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan dengan lantang: apa yang akan salah jika kamu mengubah beberapa hal sekaligus?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Giải thích vì sao, trong một hoặc hai câu.
vi.prompt: Vì sao một thí nghiệm khoa học công bằng chỉ thay đổi một thứ mỗi lần?
hints: Nghĩ về điều gì sẽ sai nếu bạn thay đổi nhiều thứ cùng lúc.
vi.worked_example: Nói lời giải thích của bạn thành tiếng trước. Rồi viết ra điều bạn đã nói.

feedback.correct: Chỉ thay đổi một thứ giúp bạn thấy chính xác điều gì gây ra sự khác biệt, một cách công bằng. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng: điều gì sẽ sai nếu bạn thay đổi nhiều thứ cùng lúc?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why, in one or two sentences.
questions.prompt: Why might cutting down a whole forest affect animals that don't even live directly in the trees?
hints: Think about how different living things in a forest are all connected.
questions.worked_example: Say your explanation out loud first. Then write down what you said.

feedback.correct: Everything in an ecosystem is connected, so removing trees can affect the whole food chain, not just tree-dwellers. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud: how are different living things in a forest connected to each other?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This is exactly why protecting forests matters so much for wildlife, not just the trees themselves.

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why' after sharing any science fact, and let your child answer before writing.

es.instruction: Explica por qué, en una o dos frases.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué talar todo un bosque podría afectar a animales que ni siquiera viven directamente en los árboles?
hints: Piensa en cómo están conectados entre sí los distintos seres vivos de un bosque.
es.worked_example: Di tu explicación en voz alta primero. Luego escribe lo que dijiste.

feedback.correct: Todo en un ecosistema está conectado, así que quitar árboles puede afectar a toda la cadena alimentaria, no solo a quienes viven en los árboles. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Dilo en voz alta: ¿cómo están conectados entre sí los distintos seres vivos de un bosque?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Explique pourquoi, en une ou deux phrases.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi le fait d'abattre toute une forêt pourrait-il affecter des animaux qui ne vivent même pas directement dans les arbres ?
hints: Pense à la façon dont les différents êtres vivants d'une forêt sont tous reliés entre eux.
fr.worked_example: Dis ton explication à voix haute d'abord. Puis écris ce que tu as dit.

feedback.correct: Tout, dans un écosystème, est relié, donc enlever les arbres peut affecter toute la chaîne alimentaire, pas seulement les animaux qui vivent dans les arbres. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Dis-le à voix haute : comment les différents êtres vivants d'une forêt sont-ils reliés entre eux ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Explique por quê, em uma ou duas frases.
pt.prompt: Por que derrubar uma floresta inteira pode afetar até animais que nem vivem diretamente nas árvores?
hints: Pense em como diferentes seres vivos numa floresta estão todos conectados.
pt.worked_example: Diga sua explicação em voz alta primeiro. Depois escreva o que você disse.

feedback.correct: Tudo em um ecossistema está conectado, então remover árvores pode afetar toda a cadeia alimentar, não só quem vive nas árvores. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Diga em voz alta: como diferentes seres vivos de uma floresta estão conectados entre si?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Spiega perché, in una o due frasi.
it.prompt: Perché tagliare un'intera foresta potrebbe colpire anche animali che non vivono direttamente sugli alberi?
hints: Pensa a come sono collegati tra loro i diversi esseri viventi di una foresta.
it.worked_example: Di' prima la tua spiegazione ad alta voce. Poi scrivi quello che hai detto.

feedback.correct: Tutto in un ecosistema è collegato, quindi togliere gli alberi può colpire l'intera catena alimentare, non solo chi vive sugli alberi. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Dillo ad alta voce: come sono collegati tra loro i diversi esseri viventi di una foresta?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum könnte das Abholzen eines ganzen Waldes Tiere beeinflussen, die nicht einmal direkt in den Bäumen leben?
hints: Denk darüber nach, wie verschiedene Lebewesen in einem Wald alle miteinander verbunden sind.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Erklärung zuerst laut aus. Schreib dann auf, was du gesagt hast.

feedback.correct: Alles in einem Ökosystem ist verbunden, daher kann das Entfernen von Bäumen die ganze Nahrungskette betreffen, nicht nur Baumbewohner. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es laut aus: Wie sind verschiedene Lebewesen in einem Wald miteinander verbunden?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Leg uit waarom, in één of twee zinnen.
nl.prompt: Waarom kan het omhakken van een heel bos ook dieren beïnvloeden die niet eens rechtstreeks in de bomen leven?
hints: Denk aan hoe verschillende levende wezens in een bos allemaal met elkaar verbonden zijn.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je uitleg eerst hardop. Schrijf dan op wat je zei.

feedback.correct: Alles in een ecosysteem is verbonden, dus het verwijderen van bomen kan de hele voedselketen beïnvloeden, niet alleen de dieren die in de bomen leven. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het hardop: hoe zijn verschillende levende wezens in een bos met elkaar verbonden?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.
ru.prompt: Почему вырубка целого леса может повлиять на животных, которые даже не живут прямо на деревьях?
hints: Подумай, как разные живые существа в лесу связаны друг с другом.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи своё объяснение вслух. Потом запиши то, что сказал.

feedback.correct: В экосистеме всё связано, поэтому удаление деревьев может повлиять на всю пищевую цепь, а не только на тех, кто живёт на деревьях. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Скажи вслух: как разные живые существа в лесу связаны друг с другом?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Bütün bir ormanı kesmek, doğrudan ağaçlarda yaşamayan hayvanları bile neden etkileyebilir?
hints: Bir ormandaki farklı canlıların birbirine nasıl bağlı olduğunu düşün.
tr.worked_example: Önce açıklamanı sesli söyle. Sonra söylediklerini yaz.

feedback.correct: Bir ekosistemdeki her şey birbirine bağlıdır, bu yüzden ağaçları kaldırmak sadece ağaçta yaşayanları değil, tüm besin zincirini etkileyebilir. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Sesli söyle: bir ormandaki farklı canlılar birbirine nasıl bağlıdır?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.prompt: 砍掉整片森林为什么可能会影响到那些并不直接住在树上的动物?
hints: 想一想森林里不同的生物是怎样相互联系的。
zh.worked_example: 先把你的解释大声说出来。然后把你说的话写下来。

feedback.correct: 生态系统中的一切都是相互联系的,所以砍掉树木会影响整条食物链,而不只是住在树上的动物。🌳
feedback.incorrect: 大声说出来:森林里不同的生物是怎样相互联系的?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 理由を1つか2つの文で説明しよう。
ja.prompt: 森全体を切り倒すことが、木の中に直接住んでいない動物にも影響するかもしれないのはなぜ?
hints: 森の中のさまざまな生き物がどうつながっているか考えよう。
ja.worked_example: まず説明を声に出して言おう。それから、言ったことを書こう。

feedback.correct: 生態系の中ではすべてがつながっているので、木を取り除くと木に住む生き物だけでなく食物連鎖全体に影響することがある。🌳
feedback.incorrect: 声に出して言おう:森の中のさまざまな生き物はどうつながっている?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 숲을 통째로 베어내는 것이 왜 나무 안에 살지 않는 동물들에게도 영향을 줄 수 있나요?
hints: 숲 속의 여러 생물들이 서로 어떻게 연결되어 있는지 생각해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 설명을 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요. 그다음 말한 것을 적으세요.

feedback.correct: 생태계 안의 모든 것은 서로 연결되어 있어서, 나무를 없애면 나무에 살지 않는 동물까지도 먹이사슬 전체가 영향을 받을 수 있어요. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: 소리 내어 말해 보세요: 숲 속의 여러 생물들이 서로 어떻게 연결되어 있나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Jelaskan mengapa, dalam satu atau dua kalimat.
id.prompt: Mengapa menebang seluruh hutan bisa memengaruhi hewan yang bahkan tidak tinggal langsung di pohon?
hints: Pikirkan bagaimana makhluk hidup yang berbeda di hutan semuanya saling terhubung.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan penjelasanmu dengan lantang dulu. Lalu tuliskan apa yang kamu ucapkan.

feedback.correct: Segala sesuatu dalam ekosistem saling terhubung, jadi menghilangkan pohon bisa memengaruhi seluruh rantai makanan, bukan hanya penghuni pohon. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan dengan lantang: bagaimana makhluk hidup yang berbeda di hutan saling terhubung satu sama lain?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Giải thích vì sao, trong một hoặc hai câu.
vi.prompt: Vì sao chặt hết cả một khu rừng có thể ảnh hưởng đến cả những con vật không sống trực tiếp trên cây?
hints: Nghĩ về cách các sinh vật khác nhau trong rừng đều liên kết với nhau.
vi.worked_example: Nói lời giải thích của bạn thành tiếng trước. Rồi viết ra điều bạn đã nói.

feedback.correct: Mọi thứ trong một hệ sinh thái đều liên kết với nhau, nên việc mất cây có thể ảnh hưởng đến cả chuỗi thức ăn, không chỉ những loài sống trên cây. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng: các sinh vật khác nhau trong rừng liên kết với nhau như thế nào?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why, in one or two sentences.
questions.prompt: Why do scientists test a new medicine on many people, not just one, before deciding it works?
hints: Think about whether one single result is enough to be sure of anything.
questions.worked_example: Say your explanation out loud first. Then write down what you said.

feedback.correct: One person's result could be a coincidence - testing many people makes the evidence far more reliable. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Say it out loud: why might one single test not be enough to be sure?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: writing a short causal explanation

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Testing many people, not just one, is what makes a scientific result truly trustworthy.

analysis.primary_construct: composing a brief written explanation connecting a fact to its reason
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a fact is truly understood, not just memorised, by requiring the reasoning behind it in writing.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A restated fact with no actual reasoning ('because that's how it is') shows the fact, not its cause, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just stating what, is where real science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why' after sharing any science fact, and let your child answer before writing.

es.instruction: Explica por qué, en una o dos frases.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué los científicos prueban una nueva medicina en muchas personas, no solo en una, antes de decidir que funciona?
hints: Piensa en si un solo resultado es suficiente para estar seguro de algo.
es.worked_example: Di tu explicación en voz alta primero. Luego escribe lo que dijiste.

feedback.correct: El resultado de una sola persona podría ser una coincidencia - probar en muchas personas hace que la evidencia sea mucho más confiable. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Dilo en voz alta: ¿por qué una sola prueba podría no ser suficiente para estar seguro?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Explique pourquoi, en une ou deux phrases.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi les scientifiques testent-ils un nouveau médicament sur beaucoup de personnes, pas une seule, avant de décider qu'il fonctionne ?
hints: Pense si le résultat d'une seule personne suffit vraiment pour être sûr de quelque chose.
fr.worked_example: Dis ton explication à voix haute d'abord. Puis écris ce que tu as dit.

feedback.correct: Le résultat d'une seule personne pourrait être une coïncidence - tester beaucoup de gens rend la preuve bien plus fiable. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Dis-le à voix haute : pourquoi un seul test ne suffirait-il peut-être pas pour être sûr ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Explique por quê, em uma ou duas frases.
pt.prompt: Por que os cientistas testam um novo remédio em muitas pessoas, e não apenas em uma, antes de decidir que ele funciona?
hints: Pense se um único resultado é suficiente para ter certeza de alguma coisa.
pt.worked_example: Diga sua explicação em voz alta primeiro. Depois escreva o que você disse.

feedback.correct: O resultado de uma pessoa poderia ser coincidência - testar muitas pessoas torna a evidência muito mais confiável. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Diga em voz alta: por que um único teste pode não ser suficiente para ter certeza?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Spiega perché, in una o due frasi.
it.prompt: Perché gli scienziati testano una nuova medicina su molte persone, non solo una, prima di decidere che funziona?
hints: Pensa se un solo risultato basti per essere sicuri di qualcosa.
it.worked_example: Di' prima la tua spiegazione ad alta voce. Poi scrivi quello che hai detto.

feedback.correct: Il risultato di una sola persona potrebbe essere una coincidenza - testarne molte rende la prova molto più affidabile. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Dillo ad alta voce: perché un solo test potrebbe non bastare per essere sicuri?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Erkläre warum, in ein oder zwei Sätzen.
de.prompt: Warum testen Wissenschaftler ein neues Medikament an vielen Menschen und nicht nur an einer Person, bevor sie entscheiden, dass es wirkt?
hints: Denk darüber nach, ob ein einziges Ergebnis reicht, um sich bei irgendetwas sicher zu sein.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Erklärung zuerst laut aus. Schreib dann auf, was du gesagt hast.

feedback.correct: Das Ergebnis einer einzelnen Person könnte Zufall sein – das Testen vieler Menschen macht den Beweis viel verlässlicher. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es laut aus: Warum könnte ein einziger Test nicht ausreichen, um sicher zu sein?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Leg uit waarom, in één of twee zinnen.
nl.prompt: Waarom testen wetenschappers een nieuw medicijn op veel mensen, niet op slechts één, voordat ze besluiten dat het werkt?
hints: Denk erover of één enkel resultaat genoeg is om ergens zeker van te zijn.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je uitleg eerst hardop. Schrijf dan op wat je zei.

feedback.correct: Het resultaat van één persoon kan toeval zijn - door veel mensen te testen wordt het bewijs veel betrouwbaarder. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het hardop: waarom zou één enkele test niet genoeg kunnen zijn om zeker te zijn?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Объясни почему, в одном или двух предложениях.
ru.prompt: Почему учёные испытывают новое лекарство на многих людях, а не только на одном, прежде чем решить, что оно работает?
hints: Подумай, достаточно ли одного единственного результата, чтобы быть в чём-то уверенным.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи своё объяснение вслух. Потом запиши то, что сказал.

feedback.correct: Результат одного человека может быть случайностью — испытание на многих людях делает доказательства намного надёжнее. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Скажи вслух: почему одного единственного испытания может быть недостаточно, чтобы быть уверенным?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Nedenini bir veya iki cümleyle açıkla.
tr.prompt: Bilim insanları yeni bir ilacın işe yarayıp yaramadığına karar vermeden önce neden sadece bir kişi üzerinde değil, birçok kişi üzerinde test eder?
hints: Tek bir sonucun herhangi bir şeyden emin olmak için yeterli olup olmadığını düşün.
tr.worked_example: Önce açıklamanı sesli söyle. Sonra söylediklerini yaz.

feedback.correct: Bir kişinin sonucu bir tesadüf olabilir - birçok kişiyi test etmek kanıtı çok daha güvenilir kılar. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Sesli söyle: tek bir test neden emin olmak için yeterli olmayabilir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.prompt: 科学家在确定一种新药有效之前,为什么要在很多人身上测试,而不是只测试一个人?
hints: 想一想仅凭一个结果是否足够确定任何事情。
zh.worked_example: 先把你的解释大声说出来。然后把你说的话写下来。

feedback.correct: 一个人的结果可能只是巧合——测试很多人能让证据更加可靠。💊
feedback.incorrect: 大声说出来:为什么只做一次测试可能不足以确定结果?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 理由を1つか2つの文で説明しよう。
ja.prompt: 科学者が新しい薬が効くと決める前に、1人だけでなく多くの人で試すのはなぜ?
hints: 1人だけの結果で何かを確かめるのに十分かどうか考えよう。
ja.worked_example: まず説明を声に出して言おう。それから、言ったことを書こう。

feedback.correct: 1人の結果は偶然かもしれない - 多くの人で試すことで証拠がずっと信頼できるものになる。💊
feedback.incorrect: 声に出して言おう:1回だけの実験では確かめるのに十分でないかもしれないのはなぜ?

feedback.correct: Uma explicação cuidadosa e ponderada de uma ideia científica realmente avançada. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Diga em voz alta primeiro: se o gelo continua derretendo mais a cada ano, o que isso pode sugerir, com cuidado?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.prompt: Scrivi due o tre frasi su cosa potrebbe suggerire lo sciogliersi del ghiaccio ai poli riguardo alla temperatura della Terra nel tempo.
hints: Pensa a cosa potrebbe suggerire la fusione continua nel corso di molti anni, poi scrivine con attenzione.
it.worked_example: Di' prima le tue frasi ad alta voce. Poi scrivile una alla volta.

feedback.correct: Una spiegazione attenta e accurata di un'idea scientifica davvero avanzata. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Dillo prima ad alta voce: se il ghiaccio continua a sciogliersi ogni anno, cosa potrebbe suggerire, con attenzione?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Schreib zwei oder drei Sätze.
de.prompt: Schreib zwei oder drei Sätze darüber, was schmelzendes Eis an den Polen über die Temperatur der Erde im Laufe der Zeit vermuten lassen könnte.
hints: Denk darüber nach, was anhaltendes Schmelzen über viele Jahre vermuten lassen könnte, und schreib vorsichtig darüber.
de.worked_example: Sprich deine Sätze zuerst laut aus. Schreib sie dann einen nach dem anderen auf.

feedback.correct: Eine sorgfältige, durchdachte Erklärung einer wirklich fortgeschrittenen wissenschaftlichen Idee. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Sprich es zuerst laut aus: Wenn Eis jedes Jahr weiter schmilzt, was könnte das vorsichtig vermuten lassen?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Schrijf twee of drie zinnen.
nl.prompt: Schrijf twee of drie zinnen over wat smeltend ijs op de polen kan suggereren over de temperatuur van de aarde in de tijd.
hints: Denk aan wat voortdurend smelten over vele jaren zou kunnen suggereren, schrijf er dan zorgvuldig over.
nl.worked_example: Zeg je zinnen eerst hardop. Schrijf ze dan een voor een op.

feedback.correct: Een zorgvuldige, doordachte uitleg van een echt geavanceerd wetenschappelijk idee. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Zeg het eerst hardop: als het ijs elk jaar steeds meer smelt, wat zou dat zorgvuldig kunnen suggereren?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.prompt: Напиши два или три предложения о том, что таяние льда на полюсах может говорить о температуре Земли с течением времени.
hints: Подумай, о чём может говорить продолжающееся таяние на протяжении многих лет, а затем напиши об этом внимательно.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи свои предложения вслух. Потом запиши их одно за другим.

feedback.correct: Внимательное, вдумчивое объяснение действительно сложной научной идеи. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Сначала скажи вслух: если лёд продолжает таять всё больше каждый год, о чём это может осторожно говорить?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.prompt: Kutuplardaki buzun erimesinin, zaman içinde Dünya'nın sıcaklığı hakkında neyi gösterebileceği hakkında iki veya üç cümle yaz.
hints: Yıllarca süren erimenin neyi gösterebileceğini düşün, sonra dikkatlice bunun hakkında yaz.
tr.worked_example: Önce cümlelerini sesli söyle. Sonra onları birer birer yaz.

feedback.correct: Gerçekten ileri bir bilimsel fikrin dikkatli ve düşünceli bir açıklaması. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Önce sesli söyle: buz her yıl daha fazla erirse, bu dikkatlice bakıldığında neyi gösterebilir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.prompt: 写两三句话,说说极地冰层融化可能说明了地球温度随时间发生了什么变化。
hints: 想一想多年持续融化可能说明了什么,然后仔细写下来。
zh.worked_example: 先把你的句子大声说出来。然后一句一句地写下来。

feedback.correct: 一段仔细、深思熟虑的解释,说清了这个真正进阶的科学概念。🧊
feedback.incorrect: 先大声说出来:如果冰每年都融化得更多,这仔细想想可能说明了什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 2つか3つの文を書こう。
ja.prompt: 極地の氷が溶けていることが、地球の気温が長い間どうなっているかについて何を示しているかもしれないか、2つか3つの文を書こう。
hints: 何年も溶け続けることが何を示しているか、慎重に考えて書こう。
ja.worked_example: まず文を声に出して言おう。それから1つずつ書こう。

feedback.correct: 本当に高度な科学の考えについて、慎重で丁寧な説明。🧊
feedback.incorrect: まず声に出して言おう:氷が毎年もっと溶け続けたら、それは何を示しているかもしれない?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 극지방의 얼음이 녹는 것이 시간에 따른 지구의 온도에 대해 무엇을 알려줄 수 있는지에 대해 두세 문장으로 쓰세요.
hints: 여러 해에 걸쳐 계속 얼음이 녹는 것이 무엇을 뜻할 수 있는지 생각한 다음, 신중하게 써 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 문장을 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요. 그런 다음 한 문장씩 적어 보세요.

feedback.correct: 정말 수준 높은 과학적 개념에 대한, 신중하고 깊이 있는 설명이에요. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: 먼저 소리 내어 말해 보세요: 얼음이 해마다 계속 더 많이 녹는다면, 그것은 신중히 생각했을 때 무엇을 뜻할 수 있을까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.prompt: Tulis dua atau tiga kalimat tentang apa yang mungkin disarankan oleh es yang mencair di kutub mengenai suhu Bumi dari waktu ke waktu.
hints: Pikirkan apa yang mungkin disarankan oleh pencairan yang terus berlanjut selama bertahun-tahun, lalu tuliskan dengan cermat.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan kalimatmu dengan lantang dulu. Lalu tuliskan satu per satu.

feedback.correct: Penjelasan yang cermat dan penuh pemikiran tentang gagasan sains yang benar-benar tingkat lanjut. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan dulu dengan lantang: jika es terus mencair lebih banyak tiap tahun, apa yang mungkin disarankan hal itu, secara cermat?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Viết hai hoặc ba câu.
vi.prompt: Viết hai hoặc ba câu về việc băng ở hai cực tan có thể gợi ý điều gì về nhiệt độ của Trái Đất theo thời gian.
hints: Nghĩ xem việc băng tiếp tục tan mỗi năm có thể gợi ý điều gì, rồi viết về nó, một cách cẩn trọng.
vi.worked_example: Nói các câu của bạn thành tiếng trước. Rồi viết chúng ra từng câu một.

feedback.correct: Một lời giải thích cẩn trọng, chu đáo về một ý tưởng khoa học thực sự nâng cao. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Nói thành tiếng trước: nếu băng tiếp tục tan nhiều hơn mỗi năm, điều đó có thể gợi ý gì, một cách cẩn trọng?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.
